notice: IPA Courier doesn't provide game files. Every project here needs your own legally obtained copy of the original game.

projects.name: Dusk
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
projects.summary: Native port of Twilight Princess built from its decompilation, with modern rendering and controls.
projects.requires: Your own Twilight Princess (GameCube, USA) disc image.

projects.name: Ghostship
projects.summary: Harbour Masters' Super Mario 64 port with widescreen, high frame rates and mod support.
projects.requires: Your own Super Mario 64 (N64) ROM.

projects.name: isle-portable
projects.summary: Portable build of the LEGO Island decompilation, running natively on modern systems.
projects.requires: Your own LEGO Island game files (original CD).

projects.name: DinoPad
projects.summary: Dinosaur Planet running natively on iPhone and iPad with touch controls.
projects.requires: Your own Dinosaur Planet ROM. PadMint builds the playable app from it on your Mac.

projects.name: GoldenPad
projects.summary: GoldenEye 007 natively on iPhone and iPad, with Metal rendering and touch controls.
projects.requires: Your own GoldenEye 007 ROM. PadMint builds the playable app from it on your Mac.

projects.name: BearBirdPad
projects.summary: Banjo-Kazooie on iPhone and iPad via BanjoRecomp, with native Metal rendering.
projects.requires: Your own Banjo-Kazooie ROM. PadMint builds the playable app from it on your Mac.

projects.name: BananaPad
projects.summary: Donkey Kong 64 running natively on iPhone and iPad.
projects.requires: Your own Donkey Kong 64 ROM. PadMint builds the playable app from it on your Mac.

projects.name: SquirrelPad
projects.summary: Conker's Bad Fur Day running natively on iPhone and iPad.
projects.requires: Your own Conker's Bad Fur Day ROM. PadMint builds the playable app from it on your Mac.

projects.name: MeleePad
projects.summary: Super Smash Bros. Melee natively on iPhone and iPad.
projects.requires: Your own Super Smash Bros. Melee disc image. PadMint builds the playable app from it on your Mac.

projects.name: SunPad
projects.summary: Super Mario Sunshine on iPhone and iPad through static recompilation.
projects.requires: Your own Super Mario Sunshine disc image. PadMint builds the playable app from it on your Mac.

projects.name: KartPad
projects.summary: Mario Kart Wii (with optional Retro Rewind) natively on iPhone and iPad.
projects.requires: Your own Mario Kart Wii disc image. PadMint builds the playable app from it on your Mac.

projects.name: Ship of Harkinian
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
projects.summary: The best-known Ocarina of Time PC port, with enhancements, randomizer and mod support.
projects.requires: Your own Ocarina of Time ROM (selected on first launch).

projects.name: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
projects.summary: Harbour Masters' Majora's Mask port, sibling to Ship of Harkinian.
projects.requires: Your own Majora's Mask (USA) ROM.

projects.name: SpaghettiKart
projects.summary: Mario Kart 64 port with custom tracks, widescreen and modern controls.
projects.requires: Your own Mario Kart 64 (USA) ROM.

projects.name: Zelda 64: Recompiled
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
projects.summary: Static recompilation of Majora's Mask with the RT64 renderer, widescreen and mod support.
projects.requires: Your own Majora's Mask (USA) ROM.

projects.name: Banjo: Recompiled
projects.summary: Static recompilation of Banjo-Kazooie for modern systems.
projects.requires: Your own Banjo-Kazooie ROM.

projects.name: Mario Kart 64: Recompiled
projects.summary: Static recompilation of Mario Kart 64 using N64Recomp and RT64.
projects.requires: Your own Mario Kart 64 (USA) ROM.

projects.name: Star Fox 64: Recompiled
projects.summary: Static recompilation of Star Fox 64 with high frame rates and widescreen.
projects.requires: Your own Star Fox 64 (USA) ROM.

projects.name: sm64coopdx
projects.summary: Online multiplayer Super Mario 64 with Lua mods and dozens of characters.
projects.requires: Your own Super Mario 64 (USA) ROM.

projects.name: OpenGOAL
projects.summary: Launcher for the OpenGOAL ports of Jak and Daxter, Jak II and Jak 3.
projects.requires: Your own Jak game disc images (extracted by the launcher).

projects.name: Sonic CD Decompilation
projects.summary: Decompilation of the 2011 Sonic CD remaster (Retro Engine v3).
projects.requires: Your own Data.rsdk from a purchased copy of Sonic CD (2011).

projects.name: OpenLara
projects.summary: Open-source engine for the classic Tomb Raider games.
projects.requires: Your own Tomb Raider game data (PC or PlayStation).

padmint.summary: PadMint builds the playable app from your own game file. Releases here only contain a game-free shell.
